shellCommands.command: ls -a && cat package.json && cat AGENTS.md && git ls-files | head -50 && ls -R .agents | head -50
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; ls src __agent_eval__; grep -n -i -B2 -A8 "i18n" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit configure ThemeProvider Select 2>&1 | head -40

grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/package.json; grep -n "gravity-ui/i18n" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json package-lock.json | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build 2>&1 | head -30; grep -rn "lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/configure.d.ts; sed -n 1,200p node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/README.md

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -50; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -60; cat tsconfig.json

npm install @gravity-ui/i18n@^1.8.0 2>&1 | tail -3; grep -n "ControlGroupProps" -A12 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -30; grep -n "i18n\|^export" node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/index.d.ts | tail -20; git diff package.json
